<div class="parsedown-markdown"><h2 id="55867571_&amp;#128176;-还款日历-—-多笔贷款管理工具">💰 还款日历 — 多笔贷款管理工具</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>原创开发 · 完全免费 · 无广告无内购 · 纯本地存储</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#128204;-一句话介绍">📌 一句话介绍</h3>
<p>一款帮助追踪房贷、车贷、组合贷等分期还款的轻量工具，支持多笔贷款汇总、本月到期提醒、逐期还款计划、纯本地存储 — <strong>双击 HTML 即可使用，零安装零依赖。</strong></p>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#128279;-快速体验">🔗 快速体验</h3>
<p><strong>下载 <code>app.html</code> 后双击用浏览器打开即可，Windows / macOS / Linux 通用。</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>数据保存在浏览器本地（localStorage），不上传任何服务器</li>
<li>完全离线可用，不联网、不验证、不弹广告</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#127919;-适合谁用">🎯 适合谁用</h3>
<ul>
<li>🏠 <strong>背负房贷</strong> 想清楚还剩多少本金、还剩多少利息</li>
<li>🚗 <strong>车贷/消费贷</strong> 多笔贷款并存，想统一看总账</li>
<li>👨‍👩‍👧 <strong>组合贷家庭</strong> 商贷 + 公积金贷分开统计又合并查看</li>
<li>📅 <strong>记不住还款日</strong> 每月手动算哪几天要还款</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#10024;-功能亮点">✨ 功能亮点</h3>
<h4 id="55867571_&amp;#128467;-本月视图-—-每月只看这里">🗓 本月视图 — 每月只看这里</h4>
<ul>
<li>首页展示当月 <strong>应还总额</strong></li>
<li>每笔贷款：到期日、剩余天数、一键标记"已还"</li>
<li>距到期 ≤3 天自动标红预警</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="55867571_&amp;#128203;-多笔贷款管理">📋 多笔贷款管理</h4>
<ul>
<li>支持 <strong>房贷 / 车贷 / 组合贷 / 其他</strong> 四种类型</li>
<li>组合贷展开查看商贷、公积金贷各自月供、剩余本金</li>
<li>增 / 删 / 改，随时调整</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="55867571_&amp;#128197;-完整还款计划">📅 完整还款计划</h4>
<ul>
<li>自动生成逐期等额本息还款计划</li>
<li><strong>当前期自动置顶</strong>，已还期划线高亮</li>
<li>本金/利息/剩余本金一目了然</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="55867571_&amp;#128202;-统计总览">📊 统计总览</h4>
<ul>
<li>全部负债汇总：<strong>剩余本金、月供合计、已还利息、剩余利息、剩余期数</strong></li>
<li>整体进度条，已还 vs 剩余本息对比</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="55867571_&amp;#128274;-隐私安全">🔒 隐私安全</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>纯本地存储</strong>，数据在浏览器里，不上传任何服务器</li>
<li>无广告、无内购、无联网验证</li>
<li>可 <strong>导出 TXT</strong> 账单摘要备份</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#128202;-界面预览">📊 界面预览</h3>
<pre><code>┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
│&nbsp;&nbsp;💰 还款日历&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[📥 导入] [导出]&nbsp;&nbsp;│
├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│&nbsp;&nbsp;📅 本月视图&nbsp;&nbsp;│&nbsp;&nbsp;📋 贷款管理&nbsp;&nbsp;│&nbsp;&nbsp;📊 统计&nbsp;&nbsp;│
├──────────────────────────────────────┤
│&nbsp;&nbsp;2026年9月&nbsp;&nbsp;·&nbsp;&nbsp;本月待还&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;¥ 12,450.00&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;──────────────────────────────&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;光大银行房贷&nbsp; &nbsp; 9月20日&nbsp;&nbsp;剩余10天&nbsp; &nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;¥ 9,800.00&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; │
│&nbsp;&nbsp;──────────────────────────────&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;车贷招商银行&nbsp; &nbsp; 9月1日&nbsp; &nbsp;⚠ 9天后&nbsp; &nbsp;│
│&nbsp;&nbsp;¥ 2,650.00&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; │
└──────────────────────────────────────┘</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#128229;-批量导入">📥 批量导入</h3>
<p>点击 <strong>「📥 导入」</strong> 按钮，支持 CSV 格式：</p>
<pre><code class="language-csv">名称,类型,总额,年利率(%),期数,首期日期,每月还款日,备注
光大房贷2022,房贷,1000000,4.2,360,2022-03-15,20,
车贷2023,车贷,150000,4.8,36,2023-06-01,1,
商贷组合,组合贷,800000,4.2,240,2020-01-10,15,含公积金</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>支持拖拽上传</li>
<li>导入前预览、可跳过错误行</li>
<li>组合贷自动五五拆分，导入后可编辑</li>
</ul>
<hr>

<h3 id="55867571_&amp;#128302;-未来计划（欢迎反馈）">🔮 未来计划（欢迎反馈）</h3>

&lt;script&gt;
// ─── Data Model ───────────────────────────────────────────────
const STORAGE_KEY = 'repayment_calendar_loans';
let loans = [];
let editingId = null;

function loadData() {
  try { loans = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || []; }
  catch { loans = []; }
}
function saveData() {
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(loans));
}

// ─── Calculations ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function calcMonthlyPayment(principal, annualRate, months) {
  if (!principal || !annualRate || !months) return 0;
  const r = annualRate / 100 / 12;
  if (r === 0) return principal / months;
  return principal * r * Math.pow(1 + r, months) / (Math.pow(1 + r, months) - 1);
}

function generateSchedule(loan) {
  const schedule = [];
  const months = loan.terms;
  const rates = [loan.rate];
  const principals = [loan.principal];
  const isCombo = loan.type === 'combo';

  if (isCombo) {
    const commercial = loan.commercial || {};
    const gongjijin = loan.gongjijin || {};
    const scheduleA = genSubSchedule(commercial.principal, commercial.rate, months);
    const scheduleB = genSubSchedule(gongjijin.principal, gongjijin.rate, months);
    for (let i = 0; i &lt; months; i++) {
      schedule.push({
        term: i + 1,
        date: addMonths(loan.startDate, i),
        payment: (scheduleA[i]?.payment || 0) + (scheduleB[i]?.payment || 0),
        principal: (scheduleA[i]?.principal || 0) + (scheduleB[i]?.principal || 0),
        interest: (scheduleA[i]?.interest || 0) + (scheduleB[i]?.interest || 0),
        balance: (scheduleA[i]?.balance || 0) + (scheduleB[i]?.balance || 0),
        paid: loan.paidTerms?.includes(i + 1) || false
      });
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i &lt; months; i++) {
      const r = loan.rate / 100 / 12;
      const p = calcMonthlyPayment(loan.principal, loan.rate, months);
      const interest = (i === 0 ? loan.principal : schedule[i - 1].balance) * r;
      const principalPaid = p - interest;
      const balance = Math.max(0, (i === 0 ? loan.principal : schedule[i - 1].balance) - principalPaid);
      schedule.push({
        term: i + 1,
        date: addMonths(loan.startDate, i),
        payment: p,
        principal: principalPaid,
        interest: interest,
        balance: balance,
        paid: loan.paidTerms?.includes(i + 1) || false
      });
    }
  }
  return schedule;
}

function genSubSchedule(principal, rate, months) {
  if (!principal || !rate) return Array(months).fill({ payment: 0, principal: 0, interest: 0, balance: 0 });
  const schedule = [];
  const r = rate / 100 / 12;
  const p = calcMonthlyPayment(principal, rate, months);
  for (let i = 0; i &lt; months; i++) {
    const interest = (i === 0 ? principal : schedule[i - 1].balance) * r;
    const principalPaid = p - interest;
    const balance = Math.max(0, (i === 0 ? principal : schedule[i - 1].balance) - principalPaid);
    schedule.push({ payment: p, principal: principalPaid, interest: interest, balance: balance });
  }
  return schedule;
}

function addMonths(dateStr, months) {
  const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + months);
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function getCurrentTermIndex(loan) {
  const now = new Date();
  let idx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i &lt; loan.terms; i++) {
    const termDate = new Date(addMonths(loan.startDate, i) + 'T00:00:00');
    const nextDate = new Date(addMonths(loan.startDate, i + 1) + 'T00:00:00');
    if (now &gt;= termDate &amp;&amp; now &lt; nextDate) { idx = i; break; }
    if (i === loan.terms - 1) idx = i + 1;
    if (i === 0 &amp;&amp; now &lt; termDate) { idx = 0; break; }
  }
  return Math.min(idx, loan.terms - 1);
}

function getLoanProgress(loan) {
  const schedule = generateSchedule(loan);
  const paidTerms = loan.paidTerms || [];
  const paidCount = paidTerms.length;
  const totalPaid = schedule.filter((s, i) =&gt; paidTerms.includes(i + 1))
    .reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.payment, 0);
  const totalInterest = schedule.reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.interest, 0);
  const paidInterest = schedule.filter((s, i) =&gt; paidTerms.includes(i + 1))
    .reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.interest, 0);
  const lastPaidIdx = paidTerms.length &gt; 0 ? Math.max(...paidTerms) - 1 : -1;
  const remainingPrincipal = lastPaidIdx &gt;= 0 ? schedule[lastPaidIdx].balance : loan.principal;
  const remainingInterest = totalInterest - paidInterest;
  const pct = loan.terms &gt; 0 ? (paidCount / loan.terms * 100) : 0;
  return { paidCount, totalPaid, remainingPrincipal, remainingInterest, totalInterest, pct, schedule };
}

function getMonthDueDate(loan) {
  // Next due date based on monthly due day
  const now = new Date();
  const dueDay = loan.dueDay || 1;
  const thisMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), dueDay);
  if (now &lt;= thisMonth) return { date: thisMonth, isNext: false };
  return { date: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, dueDay), isNext: true };
}

function daysUntil(date) {
  const now = new Date(); now.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const d = new Date(date); d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  return Math.ceil((d - now) / 86400000);
}

function fmt(n) {
  if (n === undefined || n === null || isNaN(n)) return '0.00';
  return n.toLocaleString('zh-CN', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}
function fmtInt(n) {
  if (n === undefined || n === null || isNaN(n)) return '0';
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString('zh-CN');
}
function fmtDate(d) {
  const dd = new Date(d + 'T00:00:00');
  return `${dd.getFullYear()}/${dd.getMonth() + 1}/${dd.getDate()}`;
}

// ─── Tab Navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────
function switchTab(tab) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b =&gt; b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(`tab-${tab}`).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('view-month').style.display = tab === 'month' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('view-loans').style.display = tab === 'loans' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('view-stats').style.display = tab === 'stats' ? '' : 'none';
  if (tab === 'month') renderMonth();
  else if (tab === 'loans') renderLoanList();
  else if (tab === 'stats') renderStats();
}

// ─── Month View ───────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderMonth() {
  const now = new Date();
  const monthName = now.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long' });
  const dueItems = [];

  loans.forEach(loan =&gt; {
    const { date: dueDate } = getMonthDueDate(loan);
    const schedule = generateSchedule(loan);
    const termIdx = getCurrentTermIndex(loan);
    const termNum = termIdx + 1;
    const currentSchedule = schedule[termIdx];
    if (!currentSchedule) return;

    const isPaid = loan.paidTerms?.includes(termNum) || false;
    const days = daysUntil(dueDate);
    const monthlyPayment = currentSchedule.payment;

    dueItems.push({
      loan,
      dueDate,
      days,
      isPaid,
      monthlyPayment,
      termNum,
      schedule: currentSchedule
    });
  });

  // Sort: unpaid first, then by days ascending
  dueItems.sort((a, b) =&gt; {
    if (a.isPaid !== b.isPaid) return a.isPaid ? 1 : -1;
    return a.days - b.days;
  });

  const totalDue = dueItems.reduce((sum, item) =&gt; sum + (item.isPaid ? 0 : item.monthlyPayment), 0);
  const totalMonthly = dueItems.reduce((sum, item) =&gt; sum + item.monthlyPayment, 0);

  // Summary card
  document.getElementById('monthSummary').innerHTML = `
    &lt;div class="month-label"&gt;${monthName}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="total-amount"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(totalDue)}&lt;small&gt; / 本月待还&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.7;margin-bottom:14px"&gt;月供合计 &amp;#165;${fmt(totalMonthly)} · ${dueItems.length}笔贷款&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="month-list"&gt;
      ${dueItems.length === 0 ? '&lt;div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;opacity:0.8"&gt;暂无贷款记录&lt;/div&gt;' : dueItems.map(item =&gt; {
        const daysText = item.isPaid ? `&lt;span class="paid-badge"&gt;&amp;#10003; 已还&lt;/span&gt;` :
          item.days &lt;= 3 ? `&lt;span class="days-urgent"&gt;&amp;#9888; ${item.days}天后&lt;/span&gt;` :
          item.days &lt;= 0 ? `&lt;span class="days-urgent"&gt;今日到期！&lt;/span&gt;` :
          `&lt;span class="days-normal"&gt;${item.days}天后&lt;/span&gt;`;
        return `&lt;div class="month-item"&gt;
          &lt;div class="month-item-left"&gt;
            &lt;div class="month-item-name"&gt;${item.loan.name}&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="month-item-detail"&gt;${fmtDate(item.dueDate)} · 第${item.termNum}期&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="month-item-right"&gt;
            &lt;div class="month-item-amount"&gt;${item.isPaid ? '&lt;span style="text-decoration:line-through;opacity:0.6"&gt;' : ''}&amp;#165;${fmt(item.monthlyPayment)}${item.isPaid ? '&lt;/span&gt;' : ''}&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div class="month-item-days"&gt;${daysText}&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;`;
      }).join('')}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  `;

  // Action buttons
  document.getElementById('monthLoans').innerHTML = `
    &lt;div style="margin-top:4px"&gt;
      ${dueItems.filter(i =&gt; !i.isPaid).map(item =&gt; `
        &lt;div class="card" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px"&gt;
          &lt;div&gt;
            &lt;div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px"&gt;${item.loan.name} 第${item.termNum}期&lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(item.monthlyPayment)}&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;button class="btn btn-success btn-sm" onclick="markPaid('${item.loan.id}', ${item.termNum})"&gt;&amp;#10003; 已还&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      `).join('')}
      ${dueItems.filter(i =&gt; i.isPaid).length &gt; 0 ? `
        &lt;div style="margin-top:8px;text-align:center"&gt;
          &lt;button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="showAllLoansPaid()"&gt;查看已还款项&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ` : ''}
    &lt;/div&gt;
  `;
}

function markPaid(loanId, termNum) {
  const loan = loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === loanId);
  if (!loan) return;
  if (!loan.paidTerms) loan.paidTerms = [];
  if (!loan.paidTerms.includes(termNum)) {
    loan.paidTerms.push(termNum);
    loan.paidTerms.sort((a, b) =&gt; a - b);
  }
  saveData();
  showToast(`已标记 ${loan.name} 第${termNum}期为已还`);
  renderMonth();
}

// ─── Loan List ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderLoanList() {
  if (loans.length === 0) {
    document.getElementById('loanList').innerHTML = `
      &lt;div class="empty"&gt;
        &lt;div class="empty-icon"&gt;&amp;#128203;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;p&gt;还没有添加任何贷款&lt;/p&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAddLoan()"&gt;+ 添加第一笔贷款&lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;`;
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('loanList').innerHTML = loans.map(loan =&gt; {
    const prog = getLoanProgress(loan);
    const typeLabels = { mortgage: '&amp;#127968; 房贷', car: '&amp;#128663; 车贷', combo: '&amp;#128279; 组合贷', other: '&amp;#128196; 其他' };
    const typeClasses = { mortgage: '', car: 'car', combo: 'combo', other: 'other' };
    const isCombo = loan.type === 'combo';
    const subLoans = isCombo ? getComboSubs(loan) : [];
    const progressColor = prog.pct &gt;= 80 ? 'var(--success)' : prog.pct &gt;= 50 ? 'var(--primary)' : 'var(--warning)';

    return `&lt;div class="card loan-card ${isCombo ? 'combo' : ''}"&gt;
      &lt;div class="loan-card-header"&gt;
        &lt;div&gt;
          &lt;span class="loan-type-badge ${typeClasses[loan.type]}"&gt;${typeLabels[loan.type]}&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;div class="loan-name"&gt;${loan.name}&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="loan-amount"&gt;总额 &amp;#165;${fmtInt(loan.principal)} · 年利率 ${loan.rate}% · ${loan.terms}期&lt;/div&gt;
          ${loan.note ? `&lt;div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px"&gt;${loan.note}&lt;/div&gt;` : ''}
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn-icon" onclick="deleteLoan('${loan.id}')" style="background:#fef2f2;color:var(--danger);border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px" title="删除"&gt;&amp;#128465;&lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;div class="loan-stats"&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余本金&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(prog.remainingPrincipal)}&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余利息&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(prog.remainingInterest)}&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;已还本息&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-value success"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(prog.totalPaid)}&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余期数&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div class="stat-value warning"&gt;${loan.terms - prog.paidCount}期&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      ${isCombo ? `
        &lt;div style="margin-bottom:10px"&gt;
          &lt;button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="showComboDetail('${loan.id}')" style="width:100%"&gt;&amp;#128279; 查看组合贷明细&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="sub-loans"&gt;
          ${subLoans.map(s =&gt; `
            &lt;div class="sub-loan-item"&gt;
              &lt;div class="sub-loan-header"&gt;
                &lt;span class="sub-loan-name"&gt;${s.name}&lt;/span&gt;
                &lt;span class="sub-loan-amount"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(s.monthlyPayment)}/月&lt;/span&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;div class="sub-loan-stats"&gt;
                &lt;div class="sub-loan-stat"&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-label"&gt;本金&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-val"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(s.principal)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;div class="sub-loan-stat"&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-label"&gt;利率&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-val"&gt;${s.rate}%&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;div class="sub-loan-stat"&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-label"&gt;剩余&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="sub-loan-stat-val"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(s.remaining)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
              &lt;/div&gt;
            &lt;/div&gt;
          `).join('')}
        &lt;/div&gt;
      ` : ''}

      &lt;div class="progress-wrap" style="margin-top:10px"&gt;
        &lt;div class="progress-bar ${isCombo ? 'combo' : ''}" style="width:${prog.pct.toFixed(1)}%;background:${progressColor}"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="progress-text"&gt;已还 ${prog.paidCount}/${loan.terms} 期 (${prog.pct.toFixed(1)}%)&lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;div class="loan-card-footer"&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="openSchedule('${loan.id}')"&gt;&amp;#128197; 还款计划&lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="openEditLoan('${loan.id}')"&gt;&amp;#9999;&amp;#65039; 编辑&lt;/button&gt;
        ${loan.paidTerms?.length &gt; 0 ? `&lt;button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="resetPaid('${loan.id}')"&gt;&amp;#8634; 重置还款&lt;/button&gt;` : ''}
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;`;
  }).join('');
}

function getComboSubs(loan) {
  if (loan.type !== 'combo') return [];
  const c = loan.commercial || {};
  const g = loan.gongjijin || {};
  const months = loan.terms;
  return [
    { name: '商贷', principal: c.principal || 0, rate: c.rate || loan.rate, monthlyPayment: calcMonthlyPayment(c.principal, c.rate, months) },
    { name: '公积金贷', principal: g.principal || 0, rate: g.rate || loan.rate, monthlyPayment: calcMonthlyPayment(g.principal, g.rate, months) }
  ].filter(s =&gt; s.principal &gt; 0).map(s =&gt; {
    const sched = genSubSchedule(s.principal, s.rate, months);
    const paidTerms = loan.paidTerms || [];
    let lastPaidIdx = paidTerms.length &gt; 0 ? Math.max(...paidTerms) - 1 : -1;
    const remaining = lastPaidIdx &gt;= 0 ? sched[lastPaidIdx]?.balance || 0 : s.principal;
    return { ...s, remaining };
  });
}

// ─── Stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderStats() {
  let totalPrincipal = 0, totalRemaining = 0, totalMonthly = 0, totalRemainingInterest = 0;
  let totalPaidInterest = 0, totalPaidPrincipal = 0;
  let totalTerms = 0, totalRemainingTerms = 0;

  loans.forEach(loan =&gt; {
    const prog = getLoanProgress(loan);
    totalPrincipal += loan.principal;
    totalRemaining += prog.remainingPrincipal;
    totalRemainingInterest += prog.remainingInterest;
    totalMonthly += prog.schedule[getCurrentTermIndex(loan)]?.payment || 0;
    const paidSched = prog.schedule.filter((s, i) =&gt; loan.paidTerms?.includes(i + 1));
    totalPaidInterest += paidSched.reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.interest, 0);
    totalPaidPrincipal += paidSched.reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.principal, 0);
    totalTerms += loan.terms;
    totalRemainingTerms += loan.terms - prog.paidCount;
  });

  const overallPct = totalPrincipal &gt; 0 ? (1 - totalRemaining / totalPrincipal) * 100 : 0;

  document.getElementById('statsGrid').innerHTML = `
    &lt;div class="stats-card highlight"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;总负债&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalPrincipal)}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="stats-card highlight"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;剩余本金&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value" style="color:#fca5a5"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalRemaining)}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="stats-card"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;月供合计&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value" style="color:var(--primary)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(totalMonthly)}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="stats-card"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;剩余利息&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value warning"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalRemainingInterest)}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="stats-card"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;已还利息&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value success"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalPaidInterest)}&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="stats-card"&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-label"&gt;剩余期数&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="stats-value"&gt;${totalRemainingTerms}期&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class="card" style="grid-column:1/-1"&gt;
      &lt;div class="section-title" style="margin-bottom:8px"&gt;整体还款进度&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="progress-wrap" style="height:10px"&gt;
        &lt;div class="progress-bar" style="width:${overallPct.toFixed(1)}%"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:6px;font-size:13px"&gt;
        &lt;span style="color:var(--success)"&gt;已还 &amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalPaidPrincipal + totalPaidInterest)}&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;总进度 ${overallPct.toFixed(1)}%&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;span style="color:var(--warning)"&gt;剩余 &amp;#165;${fmtInt(totalRemaining + totalRemainingInterest)}&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  `;

  document.getElementById('statsDetail').innerHTML = loans.map(loan =&gt; {
    const prog = getLoanProgress(loan);
    const currentIdx = getCurrentTermIndex(loan);
    const currentSched = prog.schedule[currentIdx];
    return `&lt;div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)"&gt;
      &lt;div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center"&gt;
        &lt;div&gt;
          &lt;div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px"&gt;${loan.name}&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(loan.principal)} · ${loan.rate}% · ${loan.terms}期&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div style="text-align:right"&gt;
          &lt;div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--primary)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(currentSched?.payment || 0)}/月&lt;/div&gt;
          &lt;div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;剩余 ${loan.terms - prog.paidCount}期&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="progress-wrap" style="margin-top:8px"&gt;
        &lt;div class="progress-bar" style="width:${prog.pct.toFixed(1)}%"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;`;
  }).join('');
}

// ─── Modals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function openAddLoan() {
  editingId = null;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = '添加贷款';
  document.getElementById('saveBtn').textContent = '保存';
  clearForm();
  document.getElementById('loanModal').style.display = '';
}

function openEditLoan(id) {
  const loan = loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === id);
  if (!loan) return;
  editingId = id;
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = '编辑贷款';
  document.getElementById('saveBtn').textContent = '更新';
  document.getElementById('f_name').value = loan.name || '';
  document.getElementById('f_type').value = loan.type || 'mortgage';
  document.getElementById('f_principal').value = loan.principal || '';
  document.getElementById('f_rate').value = loan.rate || '';
  document.getElementById('f_terms').value = loan.terms || '';
  document.getElementById('f_start').value = loan.startDate || '';
  document.getElementById('f_day').value = loan.dueDay || 1;
  document.getElementById('f_note').value = loan.note || '';

  if (loan.type === 'combo') {
    document.getElementById('f_commercial_principal').value = loan.commercial?.principal || '';
    document.getElementById('f_commercial_rate').value = loan.commercial?.rate || '';
    document.getElementById('f_gongjijin_principal').value = loan.gongjijin?.principal || '';
    document.getElementById('f_gongjijin_rate').value = loan.gongjijin?.rate || '';
  }
  onTypeChange();
  document.getElementById('loanModal').style.display = '';
}

function clearForm() {
  ['f_name','f_principal','f_rate','f_terms','f_start','f_note',
   'f_commercial_principal','f_commercial_rate','f_gongjijin_principal','f_gongjijin_rate'].forEach(id =&gt; {
    document.getElementById(id).value = '';
  });
  document.getElementById('f_type').value = 'mortgage';
  document.getElementById('f_day').value = '1';
  onTypeChange();
}

function onTypeChange() {
  const type = document.getElementById('f_type').value;
  document.getElementById('comboSection').style.display = type === 'combo' ? '' : 'none';
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById('loanModal').style.display = 'none';
  editingId = null;
}

function saveLoan() {
  const name = document.getElementById('f_name').value.trim();
  const type = document.getElementById('f_type').value;
  const principal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_principal').value) || 0;
  const rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_rate').value) || 0;
  const terms = parseInt(document.getElementById('f_terms').value) || 0;
  const startDate = document.getElementById('f_start').value;
  const dueDay = parseInt(document.getElementById('f_day').value) || 1;
  const note = document.getElementById('f_note').value.trim();

  if (!name) { showToast('请输入贷款名称'); return; }
  if (principal &lt;= 0) { showToast('请输入正确的贷款金额'); return; }
  if (rate &lt;= 0) { showToast('请输入年利率'); return; }
  if (terms &lt;= 0) { showToast('请输入还款期数'); return; }
  if (!startDate) { showToast('请选择首期还款日期'); return; }

  const loanData = {
    id: editingId || Date.now().toString(),
    name, type, principal, rate, terms, startDate, dueDay, note,
    paidTerms: editingId ? (loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === editingId)?.paidTerms || []) : [],
    commercial: null,
    gongjijin: null
  };

  if (type === 'combo') {
    loanData.commercial = {
      principal: parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_commercial_principal').value) || 0,
      rate: parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_commercial_rate').value) || rate
    };
    loanData.gongjijin = {
      principal: parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_gongjijin_principal').value) || 0,
      rate: parseFloat(document.getElementById('f_gongjijin_rate').value) || rate
    };
    if (!loanData.commercial.principal &amp;&amp; !loanData.gongjijin.principal) {
      showToast('请至少填一项子贷款金额');
      return;
    }
    // 用商贷+公积金总额验证
    const subTotal = (loanData.commercial?.principal || 0) + (loanData.gongjijin?.principal || 0);
    if (Math.abs(subTotal - principal) &gt; 1) {
      loanData.principal = subTotal || principal;
    }
  }

  if (editingId) {
    const idx = loans.findIndex(l =&gt; l.id === editingId);
    if (idx &gt;= 0) loans[idx] = loanData;
  } else {
    loans.push(loanData);
  }

  saveData();
  closeModal();
  showToast(editingId ? '贷款已更新' : '贷款已添加');
  renderAll();
}

function deleteLoan(id) {
  if (!confirm('确定删除这笔贷款？还款记录将一并清除。')) return;
  loans = loans.filter(l =&gt; l.id !== id);
  saveData();
  showToast('已删除');
  renderAll();
}

function resetPaid(id) {
  if (!confirm('重置后所有已还期数将清空，确定？')) return;
  const loan = loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === id);
  if (loan) { loan.paidTerms = []; saveData(); showToast('已重置'); renderAll(); }
}

// ─── Schedule Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────
function openSchedule(loanId) {
  const loan = loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === loanId);
  if (!loan) return;
  const prog = getLoanProgress(loan);
  const sched = prog.schedule;

  document.getElementById('scheduleTitle').textContent = `${loan.name} — 还款计划`;
  document.getElementById('scheduleInfo').innerHTML = `
    &lt;div&gt;&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;总额&lt;/span&gt; &lt;strong&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(loan.principal)}&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;月供&lt;/span&gt; &lt;strong style="color:var(--primary)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(calcMonthlyPayment(loan.principal, loan.rate, loan.terms))}&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;总利息&lt;/span&gt; &lt;strong style="color:var(--warning)"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(prog.totalInterest)}&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div&gt;&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;已还&lt;/span&gt; &lt;strong style="color:var(--success)"&gt;${prog.paidCount}期&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
  `;

  const now = new Date();
  const currentIdx = getCurrentTermIndex(loan);

  document.getElementById('scheduleBody').innerHTML = sched.map((s, i) =&gt; {
    const isCurrent = i === currentIdx &amp;&amp; !loan.paidTerms?.includes(i + 1);
    const isPaid = loan.paidTerms?.includes(i + 1);
    let rowClass = '';
    if (isPaid) rowClass = 'paid';
    else if (isCurrent) rowClass = 'current';
    return `&lt;tr class="${rowClass}"&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;${i + 1}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;${fmtDate(s.date)}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td class="num"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(s.payment)}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td class="num"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(s.principal)}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td class="num"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(s.interest)}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td class="num"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(s.balance)}&lt;/td&gt;
      &lt;td&gt;${isPaid ? '&lt;span style="color:var(--success)"&gt;&amp;#10003;已还&lt;/span&gt;' : isCurrent ? '&lt;span style="color:var(--primary)"&gt;当前&lt;/span&gt;' : '&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;—&lt;/span&gt;'}&lt;/td&gt;
    &lt;/tr&gt;`;
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('scheduleModal').style.display = '';
}

function closeScheduleModal() {
  document.getElementById('scheduleModal').style.display = 'none';
}

// ─── Combo Detail Modal ────────────────────────────────────────
function showComboDetail(loanId) {
  const loan = loans.find(l =&gt; l.id === loanId);
  if (!loan || loan.type !== 'combo') return;

  const c = loan.commercial || {};
  const g = loan.gongjijin || {};
  const months = loan.terms;

  const subs = [
    { key: 'commercial', name: '商贷', principal: c.principal, rate: c.rate },
    { key: 'gongjijin', name: '公积金贷', principal: g.principal, rate: g.rate }
  ].filter(s =&gt; s.principal &gt; 0);

  document.getElementById('comboDetailBody').innerHTML = subs.map(sub =&gt; {
    const sched = genSubSchedule(sub.principal, sub.rate, months);
    const paidTerms = loan.paidTerms || [];
    const monthly = calcMonthlyPayment(sub.principal, sub.rate, months);
    const totalInterest = sched.reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.interest, 0);
    const paidSched = sched.filter((s, i) =&gt; paidTerms.includes(i + 1));
    const paidInterest = paidSched.reduce((sum, s) =&gt; sum + s.interest, 0);
    const lastPaidIdx = paidTerms.length &gt; 0 ? Math.max(...paidTerms) - 1 : -1;
    const remaining = lastPaidIdx &gt;= 0 ? sched[lastPaidIdx]?.balance || 0 : sub.principal;
    const remainingInterest = totalInterest - paidInterest;

    return `&lt;div class="card" style="border-left:3px solid #9333ea;margin-bottom:12px"&gt;
      &lt;div style="font-weight:700;font-size:16px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#9333ea"&gt;${sub.name}&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class="loan-stats"&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;本金&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(sub.principal)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;年利率&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;${sub.rate}%&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;月供&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmt(monthly)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余本金&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(remaining)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余利息&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value"&gt;&amp;#165;${fmtInt(remainingInterest)}&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class="stat-item"&gt;&lt;div class="stat-label"&gt;剩余期数&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class="stat-value warning"&gt;${months - paidTerms.length}期&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;`;
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('comboDetailModal').style.display = '';
}

function closeComboModal() {
  document.getElementById('comboDetailModal').style.display = 'none';
}

// ─── Import ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
let importData = [];

function openImportModal() {
  importData = [];
  document.getElementById('importPreview').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('importError').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('confirmImportBtn').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('importModal').style.display = '';
}

function closeImportModal() {
  document.getElementById('importModal').style.display = 'none';
}

function handleDrop(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.getElementById('dropZone').style.borderColor = 'var(--border)';
  const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
  if (file) parseImportFile(file);
}

function handleFileSelect(e) {
  const file = e.target.files[0];
  if (file) parseImportFile(file);
}

function parseImportFile(file) {
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e) { parseCSV(e.target.result); };
  reader.readAsText(file, 'UTF-8');
}

function parseCSV(text) {
  document.getElementById('importError').style.display = 'none';
  const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(l =&gt; l.trim());
  if (lines.length === 0) { showImportError('文件为空'); return; }
  let startIdx = 0;
  const firstLower = lines[0].toLowerCase();
  if (firstLower.includes('名称') || firstLower.includes('name') || firstLower.includes('loan')) startIdx = 1;

  const results = [], errors = [];
  for (let i = startIdx; i &lt; lines.length; i++) {
    const cols = parseCSVLine(lines[i]);
    if (cols.length &lt; 5) { errors.push('行' + (i + 1) + ': 列数不足'); continue; }
    const name = cols[0].trim();
    const typeMap = { '房贷': 'mortgage', '车贷': 'car', '组合贷': 'combo', '其他': 'other' };
    const type = typeMap[cols[1].trim()] || 'other';
    const principal = parseFloat(cols[2].replace(/[,，￥&amp;#165;\s]/g, '')) || 0;
    const rate = parseFloat(cols[3].replace(/[,，%\s]/g, '')) || 0;
    const terms = parseInt(cols[4]) || 0;
    const startDate = cols[5] || '';
    const dueDay = parseInt(cols[6]) || 1;
    const note = (cols[7] || '').trim();
    if (!name) { errors.push('行' + (i + 1) + ': 名称为空'); continue; }
    if (principal &lt;= 0) { errors.push('行' + (i + 1) + ': 金额无效'); continue; }
    if (rate &lt;= 0) { errors.push('行' + (i + 1) + ': 利率无效'); continue; }
    if (terms &lt;= 0) { errors.push('行' + (i + 1) + ': 期数无效'); continue; }
    const loanData = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + '_' + i,
      name, type, principal, rate, terms,
      startDate: isValidDate(startDate) ? startDate : getDefaultStartDate(),
      dueDay, note, paidTerms: [], commercial: null, gongjijin: null
    };
    if (type === 'combo') {
      const half = principal / 2;
      loanData.commercial = { principal: half, rate: rate };
      loanData.gongjijin = { principal: half, rate: +(rate * 0.75).toFixed(3) };
    }
    results.push(loanData);
  }
  if (errors.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; results.length === 0) { showImportError(errors.join('；')); return; }
  importData = results;
  const typeLabels = { mortgage: '&amp;#127968; 房贷', car: '&amp;#128663; 车贷', combo: '&amp;#128279; 组合贷', other: '&amp;#128196; 其他' };
  document.getElementById('previewCount').textContent = results.length;
  document.getElementById('previewList').innerHTML = results.map(l =&gt;
    '&lt;div style="padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px"&gt;' +
    '&lt;span style="font-weight:600"&gt;' + l.name + '&lt;/span&gt;' +
    '&lt;span style="color:var(--text-muted)"&gt;' + typeLabels[l.type] + ' · &amp;#165;' + fmtInt(l.principal) + ' · ' + l.rate + '% · ' + l.terms + '期&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;'
  ).join('');
  document.getElementById('importPreview').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('confirmImportBtn').disabled = results.length === 0;
  if (errors.length &gt; 0) showImportError('部分行有问题已跳过：' + errors.slice(0, 3).join('；') + (errors.length &gt; 3 ? '…' : ''));
}

function parseCSVLine(line) {
  const result = [], current = '';
  let inQuote = false, buf = '';
  for (let i = 0; i &lt; line.length; i++) {
    const ch = line[i];
    if (ch === '"') { if (inQuote &amp;&amp; line[i + 1] === '"') { buf += '"'; i++; } else inQuote = !inQuote; }
    else if ((ch === ',' || ch === '\t') &amp;&amp; !inQuote) { result.push(buf); buf = ''; }
    else buf += ch;
  }
  result.push(buf);
  return result;
}

function isValidDate(s) { return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(s) &amp;&amp; !isNaN(Date.parse(s)); }

function getDefaultStartDate() {
  const d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-01';
}

function showImportError(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById('importError');
  el.textContent = '&amp;#9888;&amp;#65039; ' + msg;
  el.style.display = '';
}

function confirmImport() {
  if (importData.length === 0) return;
  loans = loans.concat(importData);
  saveData();
  closeImportModal();
  showToast('成功导入 ' + importData.length + ' 笔贷款');
  renderAll();
}

// ─── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function exportData() {
  if (loans.length === 0) { showToast('暂无数据可导出'); return; }
  const summary = loans.map(l =&gt; {
    const p = getLoanProgress(l);
    return `${l.name}\t${l.type}\t&amp;#165;${fmtInt(l.principal)}\t${l.rate}%\t${l.terms}期\t已还${p.paidCount}期\t剩余&amp;#165;${fmtInt(p.remainingPrincipal)}\t剩余利息&amp;#165;${fmtInt(p.remainingInterest)}`;
  }).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob(['贷款名称\t类型\t总额\t利率\t期数\t进度\t剩余本金\t剩余利息\n' + summary], { type: 'text/plain' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `还款日历_${new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN').replace(/\//g, '-')}.txt`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('已导出');
}

function showAllLoansPaid() {
  showToast('本月所有贷款均已还清！&amp;#127881;');
}

// ─── Toast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function showToast(msg) {
  const el = document.getElementById('toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(() =&gt; el.classList.remove('show'), 2500);
}

// ─── Render All ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function renderAll() {
  renderMonth();
  renderLoanList();
  renderStats();
}

// ─── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
loadData();
renderAll();

});
document.getElementById('scheduleModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeScheduleModal();
});
document.getElementById('importModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeImportModal();
});

document.getElementById('comboDetailModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closeComboModal();
});

// Keyboard shortcuts
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    closeModal();
    closeScheduleModal();
    closeComboModal();
  }
});
